findings.title: Client-Side Obligations for Performance
findings.rationale: The vendor relies on the client to provide various forms of Confidential Information necessary for the collaboration, including operational models, project plans, and compliance interpretations, which are essential for the vendor's performance.
evidence_excerpts: Such information includes, but is not limited to, engineering documentation such as block diagrams, circuit layouts, PCB manufacturing files, embedded code, source binaries, firmware logic, secure boot designs, encryption key structures for testing, device communication protocols, debugging tools, prototype devices, testing rigs, engineering samples, and custom embedded software created by or for either Party.

findings.title: Conditions for Termination for Cause
findings.rationale: The evidence outlines the consequences of breaches, including the right to terminate existing contracts and seek injunctive relief, which indicates conditions under which the agreement can be terminated for cause.
evidence_excerpts: the Disclosing Party may suspend ongoing work, restrict access, terminate existing contracts, and demand immediate return of all Confidential Information.

findings.title: Confidentiality Obligations Survival Period
findings.rationale: The confidentiality obligations contained herein shall survive termination and shall continue to bind both Parties for a period of five (5) years from the date of termination or final disclosure, whichever is later.
evidence_excerpts: The confidentiality obligations contained herein shall survive termination and shall continue to bind both Parties for a period of five (5) years from the date of termination or final disclosure, whichever is later.

findings.title: Intellectual Property Ownership
findings.rationale: The evidence explicitly states that all intellectual property rights connected to the Confidential Information remain solely with the Disclosing Party, indicating ownership of any work product created under this agreement.
evidence_excerpts: All intellectual property rights connected to the Confidential Information remain solely with the Disclosing Party.

findings.title: Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
findings.rationale: The evidence explicitly outlines the governing law and dispute resolution process, including arbitration.
evidence_excerpts: This Agreement shall be governed by and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the jurisdiction mutually agreed between the Parties. In case a dispute arises regarding interpretation, execution, breach, or validity of this Agreement, the Parties shall initially attempt to resolve such disputes through discussions held in good faith between senior-level representatives. If amicable resolution cannot be achieved within thirty days, the matter shall be referred to binding arbitration conducted by one or more arbitrators appointed jointly by the Parties.

findings.title: Assignment and Change of Control Restrictions
findings.rationale: The contract explicitly states that neither Party may assign, transfer, or delegate its rights or obligations without written approval from the other Party.
evidence_excerpts: Neither Party may assign, transfer, or delegate its rights or obligations without written approval from the other Party.
